turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (1 to 30 September) there were 9 signups (new customers), 10 active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order), and 9 customers to date (everyone signed up by 30 September), since "customers" can mean any of these. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
